notes.body: Michael Rueckert's 2022 reply was warm and specifically asked about insurance, ticket rate and revenue share. Current official Snowbasin materials list the Events team at events@snowbasin.com / 801-620-1075. Gmail was checked and no later SnowWiesn relationship was found. A new draft is prepared to the current Events team with Michael copied, continuing from the old conversation rather than reintroducing cold. It asks whether a remaining 2026 weekend or 2027 opportunity exists and explains the current $2M liability coverage plus possible pay-for-play structure without promising a specific date before route/package availability is checked.
